formula: The time has come to + base verb + other information

formulas.formula: The time has come to + base verb + other information

example: The time has come to reconsider the policy.
exampleZh: 是時候重新考慮這項政策了。

examples.en: The time has come to reconsider the policy.
examples.zh: 是時候重新考慮這項政策了。
examples.highlight: The time has come to reconsider the policy.

rules.zh: 核心句型是：【The time has come to + base verb.】 是時候採取行動了。 是時候作出決定了。 是時候檢討規則了。 句中的 to + 動詞說明現在應該採取甚麼行動。
rules.en: The core expression is fixed The time has come to + base verb. The time has come to act. The time has come to make a decision. The time has come to review the rules.

rules.zh: 在 The time has come to 後面，to 是不定詞標記，因此必須接動詞原形，例如 change；不可接 changed 或 changing。
rules.en: Use the base form after “to” The time has come to change the plan. The time has come to changed the plan. The time has come to changing the plan.

rules.zh: 從文法上看，句子的主詞是 the time，但時間本身不會採取行動。這句並不是說 the time 會修橋，而是表示相關人士、政府部門、工程團隊或社區現在應該修橋。真正採取行動的人通常由上下文決定。
rules.en: The action is performed by an understood person or group The time has come to repair the bridge.

rules.zh: 以下內容可以加入句子，但並不是固定句型的一部分：【after years of discussion；following the successful trial；in my view；perhaps；at last；finally；before the problem becomes worse；After years of discussion, the time has come to make a decision.】 經過多年討論，是時候作出決定了。 核心句型仍然是：【the time has come to make a decision】 只是提供背景。
rules.en: Introductory information is optional after years of discussion following the successful trial in my view perhaps at last finally before the problem becomes worse After years of discussion, the time has come to make a decision. the time has come to make a decision After years of discussion

rules.zh: 我認為是時候改變計劃了。 委員會同意是時候採取行動了。 報告總結認為，是時候更新系統了。 前面的字詞是外層句法，不屬於核心固定句型。
rules.en: The expression can appear inside a larger sentence After a thinking or reporting verb Subject + think / believe / agree / say + (that) + the time has come to + verb. I think the time has come to change the plan. The committee agrees that the time has come to act. The report concludes that the time has come to update the system. The words before the time has come are optional outer structures. They are not part of the fixed expression. the time has come

rules.zh: 是否已經到了更換舊設備的時候？ 我們是否應該改變一貫的做法了？ 問句形式比直接陳述較為開放，表示說話者希望先聽取意見。
rules.en: It can be used as a direct question Has the time come to + base verb? Has the time come to replace the old equipment? Has the time come to change our approach?

rules.zh: 你認為我們是否應該搬遷了？ 本區居民是否認為應該限制交通了？ 這種結構常用於會議、討論、訪問及意見調查。
rules.en: It can appear inside another question Do you think the time has come to + base verb? Do you think the time has come to move? Do local residents feel the time has come to limit traffic?

rules.zh: 小組必須考慮是否已經到了修改規則的時候。 問題是現在是否應該擴展服務。 詞語【whether】表示這件事仍有待考慮，尚未完全確定。
rules.en: It can follow “whether” Subject + consider / decide / ask + whether the time has come to + verb. The panel must consider whether the time has come to change the rules. The question is whether the time has come to expand the service.

rules.zh: 現在尚未到公布結果的時候。 現在尚未到重開道路的時候。 這個否定形式表示現在仍然太早，適當時機尚未來到。不要混淆：【The time has not yet come to announce the result.】 現在仍未到公布結果的時候。 是時候不要公布結果了。 第二句的 not 是否定 announce，意思完全不同，而且通常不是最自然的表達方法。
rules.en: A limited negative form is possible The time has not yet come to + base verb. The time has not yet come to announce the result. The time has not yet come to reopen the road. The time has come not to announce the result.

rules.zh: 終於是時候開始這個項目了。 現在是時候作出選擇了。 或許是時候嘗試另一種方法了。 這些副詞只用來增加態度、時間感或強調效果，並非固定句型的必要部分。
rules.en: Adverbs may be inserted, but they are optional Common optional adverbs include: finally now at last perhaps The time has finally come to begin the project. Now, the time has come to make a choice. Perhaps the time has come to try a different approach. The adverbs add attitude or emphasis. They are not compulsory parts of the expression.

rules.zh: 在本練習中，其他表示「是時候」的近義句式雖然意思相關，但文法不同，因此不作目標答案。本課使用 The time has come to + 動詞原形。它可獨立成句，也可接在 think、believe 或 agree 後，或放在時間和背景短語之後；無論外層句框如何改變，核心結構都保持不變。
rules.en: Related expressions are not the target structure The following expressions have related meanings, but they are grammatically different: It is time to change the plan. It is high time we changed the plan. Now is the time to change the plan. The time has come for us to change the plan. The present exercise uses: The time has come to + base verb. A strong learner should recognise and produce the following patterns. Independent statement The time has come to + verb. The time has come to act. After a thinking or reporting verb Subject + think / believe / agree + the time has come to + verb. We believe the time has come to change the system. After an introductory phrase Introductory phrase + the time has come to + verb. After months of preparation, the time has come to begin.

rules.zh: 或許是時候尋求協助了。 現在是否應該重新考慮這項決定？ 你認為現在是否應該更換這部機器？ 我們必須考慮現在是否應該擴展。 現在尚未到作出公布的時候。
rules.en: With an attitude word Perhaps / At last / Finally, + the time has come to + verb. Perhaps the time has come to ask for help. Direct question Has the time come to + verb? Has the time come to reconsider the decision? Question with “Do you think” Do you think the time has come to + verb? Do you think the time has come to replace the machine? Embedded question with “whether” Subject + consider / ask + whether the time has come to + verb. We must consider whether the time has come to expand. Negative form The time has not yet come to + verb. The time has not yet come to make an announcement.

rules.zh: 是時候向公眾解釋這項決定了。 是時候在冬季前修理這座橋了。 後面的受詞、地點、時間及其他資料是句子內容，但不屬於固定表達本身。
rules.en: With information after the action The time has come to + verb + object / place / time / reason. The time has come to explain the decision to the public. The time has come to repair the bridge before winter. The additional information is optional. It does not form part of the fixed expression.

benefits.zh: 這個句型可以清楚表示：等待、討論或拖延的階段已經結束，現在應該採取行動。是時候作出決定了。 讀者會立即明白，這項決定不能再無限期拖延。
benefits.en: It clearly announces that action is now necessary The time has come to make a decision.

benefits.zh: 普通的 should 可以提出建議：【We should update the system.】 我們應該更新系統。 目標表達【The time has come to】則能表達更強的時機感：【The time has come to update the system.】 是時候更新系統了。 第二句聽起來較堅定，適合用於演說、會議、報告、建議書及重要討論。
benefits.en: It gives a statement more weight We should update the system. The time has come to The time has come to update the system.

benefits.zh: 詞語【has come】是現在完成式，能把之前的等待、準備、問題或變化連接到現在。經過數月測試，是時候推出產品了。 這句讓讀者明白，現在的行動是之前一連串事情發展後的結果。
benefits.en: It connects the past situation with the present decision After months of testing, the time has come to launch the product.

benefits.zh: 你可以用較簡潔而有力的方式，表達「已經到了應該做某事的階段」。
benefits.en: It can replace a longer explanation Instead of writing: We have reached a point at which we should reconsider the policy. You can write: The time has come to reconsider the policy.

benefits.zh: 是時候修改規則了。 現在是否應該修改規則？ 因此，這個句型既可以用來表達立場，也可以用來開展討論。
benefits.en: It works well in both statements and questions You can make a strong statement: The time has come to change the rules. You can also invite discussion: Has the time come to change the rules?

benefits.zh: 你不需要每次都把句子寫成：【The time has come to...】 你也可以寫：【I believe the time has come to...；After several delays, the time has come to...；Perhaps the time has come to...；Do you think the time has come to...?；The question is whether the time has come to...】 這些變化能避免所有句子使用相同開頭，令說話及寫作更自然。
benefits.en: It gives learners several useful sentence openings The time has come to... I believe the time has come to... After several delays, the time has come to... Perhaps the time has come to... Do you think the time has come to...? The question is whether the time has come to...
